mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.5%, it indicates active monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered periods, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly rising housing starts and retail sales indicate strengthening consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through improved corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.5%, it signals a labor market recovery phase where improving job conditions boost consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered periods, or the signal's Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production indicates expanding manufacturing capacity and economic growth, supporting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days without requiring specific thresholds.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 1400.0 thousand units, it signals a weakening residential sector that reduces consumer confidence and corporate revenue growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered periods, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.
